subject: pharmacology
title: Antiprotozoals: Tinidazole, Luminal Amoebicides, Nitazoxanide, Leishmania and Trypanosome Drugs

steps.tx: **Tinidazole** is metronidazole's longer lived nitroimidazole twin: single 2 gram doses cure giardiasis and trichomoniasis, two grams daily briefly serves amoebiasis, with better tolerance and the same alcohol prohibition, metallic taste and warfarin potentiation inherited from the mechanism. Its convenience is adherence pharmacology (one observed dose beats seven forgotten days), which is why sexual health and travel clinics stock it despite price.
steps.say: Tinidazole is metronidazole condensed into observed single doses; alcohol still waits.

left.title: Tinidazole niches
points: Trichomoniasis single dose with partner therapy

right.title: Shared nitroimidazole rules
points: Alcohol abstinence during and 48 to 72 hours after

steps.tx: **Diloxanide furoate** and **paromomycin** are the luminal amoebicides from the metronidazole lesson's second act: poorly absorbed agents that clear Entamoeba histolytica cysts from the colon after tissue therapy (and treat asymptomatic cyst passers), paromomycin doubling as an oral aminoglycoside for cryptosporidiosis niches and visceral leishmaniasis partnerships. Forgetting the luminal phase is the commonest amoebiasis prescribing error worldwide.
steps.say: Tissue drug then luminal drug; skipping act two schedules the relapse.

vis.alt: Amoebiasis cycle ulcer and abscess diagram showing trophozoite invasion and cyst passage
vis.caption: Amoebiasis cycle from cyst to ulcer and liver abscess, the two compartments therapy must clear.

steps.tx: **Nitazoxanide**, a nitrothiazolide blocking pyruvate ferredoxin oxidoreductase in anaerobes, treats Cryptosporidium diarrhoea (where immune reconstitution remains the real cure in HIV) and Giardia with bright yellow urine theatre, and collects viral curiosities (influenza and hepatitis trials) that never changed practice. Its examination value is breadth trivia plus the immunocompromised cryptosporidiosis caveat that drugs without immunity disappoint.
steps.say: Nitazoxanide treats crypto and giardia on paper; immune recovery treats crypto in fact.

right.title: Nitazoxanide limits
points: Advanced HIV cryptosporidiosis needs ART first
Yellow urine and stool discoloration harmless
Not a substitute for rehydration therapy

steps.tx: **Sodium stibogluconate**, pentavalent antimony, remains visceral leishmaniasis therapy where resistance (Bihar's epidemic failure) has not retired it, given intramuscularly or intravenously for 20 to 30 days against cardiotoxicity (QT, arrhythmia), pancreatitis, hepatitis and myalgia ledgers, with ECG and amylase surveillance. East African and combination regimens (with paromomycin) shorten its exposure where susceptibility patterns allow.
steps.say: Antimony cures kala azar at cardiac and pancreatic prices, where resistance still permits it.

vis.alt: Visceral leishmaniasis clinical and microscopic features illustration
vis.caption: Visceral leishmaniasis, the disease antimonials, miltefosine and amphotericin divide by geography.

steps.tx: **Miltefosine**, the oral phosphocholine analogue from oncology, became visceral leishmaniasis's first oral drug (28 days) and cutaneous niches, billing teratogenicity with months of post therapy contraception (its half life haunts), gastrointestinal intolerance and rising resistance where adherence sprawls. Liposomal amphotericin owns Indian visceral disease's single dose triumph (10 mg per kg) in elimination programmes, a regimen success that reorganised kala azar policy around one infusion.
steps.say: Miltefosine made leishmaniasis oral and teratogenic; liposomal amphotericin made it one infusion in India.

left.title: Miltefosine profile
points: Teratogenic: contraception during and months after

right.title: Amphotericin in kala azar
points: Combination short courses in East Africa

steps.tx: **Pentamidine**, an aromatic diamidine, divides its life between inhaled Pneumocystis prophylaxis (previous modules), intravenous early stage Gambian sleeping sickness and leishmaniasis alternatives, and a metabolic adverse opera: pancreatic beta cell damage causing hypoglycaemia then permanent diabetes, hypotension on infusion, renal injury and QT effects. Glucose monitoring after pentamidine is endocrinology by ambush and examinations schedule it accordingly.
steps.say: Pentamidine can diabetic a patient by pancreatic ambush; glucose follows it for weeks.

right.title: Pentamidine burdens
points: Infusion hypotension: lie flat, infuse slow

steps.tx: **Suramin**, a 1920s polysulfonated naphthylamine, treats early Rhodesian sleeping sickness before CNS invasion (and onchocerciasis history), given in escalating test dosed intravenous courses against nephrotoxicity, adrenal and neuropathy effects, while melarsoprol's arsenical encephalopathy (killing a twentieth of recipients) waits across the blood brain barrier for late stage disease where eflornithine and nifurtimox combinations have mercifully displaced it in Gambian disease.
steps.say: Suramin guards early sleeping sickness; the late stage arsenical era is mercifully closing.

nodes.label: Two year relapse surveillance with CSF

steps.tx: **Chagas disease** (benznidazole and nifurtimox, months of dermatitis and neuropathy against uncertain chronic benefit) and toxoplasmosis (sulfadiazine pyrimethamine from the sulfonamide lesson, spiramycin in pregnancy) complete the protozoal map's examinable residue. Each neglected disease's pharmacology is a study in old drugs, long courses and toxicity endured because the alternative is the parasite, which is precisely the stewardship calculus in its starkest form.
steps.say: Neglected protozoa mean old toxic drugs endured deliberately; name the trade rather than flinching from it.

left.title: Chagas therapy
points: Acute and congenital disease benefit clearest
Chronic cardiomyopathy benefit debated by trials

right.title: Toxoplasma therapy
points: Encephalitis in advanced HIV: treat and suppress
